{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Trump is likely to immediately end DACA, the Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals program, which currently protects from deportation over 4 million undocumented individuals who came to the US as minors.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Ending DACA could be the first step in the mass deportation of undocumented immigrants from the United States.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Left should build strong relationships with movements on the forefront of opposing policies related to deportation.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Left should fight to build a majoritarian coalition in support of citizenship for the millions of Americans who contribute to the economy and society through their work and taxes, but do not even enjoy the most basic civil and political rights.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Republicans may press to repeal all of the Affordable Care Act (ACA).",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Republicans can be stopped from repealing the ACA.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Organizing mass demonstrations could save the eight million working-class family members who have gained Medicaid coverage.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Organizing mass demonstrations could force the remaining 19 states that have refused to expand coverage to accept the federally funded program.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Left must organize the other 12 million people who currently receive health insurance through the ACA to demand that their coverage be continued, but at more affordable rates.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Left must campaign for state single-payer systems as the best alternative for expanding equitable and affordable health care coverage, whether all or part of the ACA is abolished.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
